item.title: WATCH: Artemis II orbits Earth for full day, takes critical step in path towards the moon
item.summary: After a picture perfect lift-off and a full day of orbiting Earth, Artemis II has fired up the crucial translunar injection.

item.title: WATCH: The translunar injection burn sending the Artemis II crew and Orion on its path toward the moon has been successfully completed.
item.summary: The translunar injection burn sending the Artemis II crew and Orion on its path toward the moon has been successfully completed.

item.summary: The trial in Lively's suit against Baldoni and Wayfarer Studios was set to begin May 18.

item.title: WATCH: Search for American journalist kidnapped in Iraq

item.title: WATCH: KitKat launches tracker after chocolate heist
item.summary: Nestlé, the maker of KitKat, has launched a tracker in an attempt to find the 12 tons of stolen chocolate.

item.title: WATCH: Artemis II crew crosses boundary into space
item.summary: The four-person crew of the Artemis II mission has crossed the boundary into space after launching from NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

item.title: WATCH: Historic Artemis II mission to the moon manned with 4 astronauts
item.summary: NASA teams cheered and crowds at Kennedy Space Center clamored to view the launch as the astronauts embarked on their voyage.

item.title: WATCH: The science behind how astronauts’ bodies respond in space
item.summary: ABC News’ Linsey Davis spoke with UCLA director of space medicine Dr. Haig Aintablian on how astronauts are preparing for their trip to space ahead of the Artemis II launch.
